_note: PAT-098 contract: /api/cql/execute with broken CQL returns 500 from GlobalExceptionHandler with structured errorInfo (phase/errorType/message) in the body. Editors previously only got a flat errorMessage string, leaving integrators with no way to distinguish translation errors from runtime errors. Phase is asserted as cql_translation — BUG-115 made the classifier walk the cause chain to recognize translator errors wrapped in CqlExecutionException.
